# Resources

* Repository name: `<your_github_username>.github.io`

* About page: <https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-about.html>

* Navigation bar: <https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-navigation.html>

* Icons: <https://icons.getbootstrap.com>

* Quarto HTML themes: <https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html>

* Listings (for displaying projects/blogs/etc.): <https://quarto.org/docs/websites/website-listings.html>

* Publishing: <https://quarto.org/docs/publishing/github-pages.html>

* Theme customization file: Download [here](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/k6vjzkiighxjf9i0574je/custom.scss?rlkey=byjp26c61wx0eerwnk0k5lb23&e=1&st=t8j3ytsi&dl=1)

* Markdown basics: <https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html>
